maddeler.e:
ينقرئ (form VII)
# يَنْقَرِئُ (yanqariʔu) /jan.qa.ri.ʔu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْقَرَأَ (inqaraʔa)
# يَنْقَرِئَ (yanqariʔa) /jan.qa.ri.ʔa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْقَرَأَ (inqaraʔa)
# يَنْقَرِئْ (yanqariʔ) /jan.qa.riʔ/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْقَرَأَ (inqaraʔa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
